$comment: Traceability matrix: every bullet of the pdfnative CHANGELOG entry named by `engine` is either exercised THROUGH the CLI (named tests, and baseline samples where a sample can show it) or waived with a reason. tests/regression/engine-surface.test.ts holds every reference to the tree. Extend it in the same change that moves the pdfnative pin (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Bumping the engine pin'). Waiver kinds: LIB (a JavaScript API a command line cannot reach), TOOLING / DOCS (the engine repository's own build, CI, samples or documentation), tested-upstream (a rule of the engine the CLI only transmits — `transmission` names the test that proves the transmission), upstream-limit (observable through the CLI but wrong or incomplete in the engine; pinned by an it.fails test and listed in ROADMAP.md).
